question: Can a single campus task-reading call made before trial 1 identify a testable uncertainty, change a locally executable experiment, and improve generalization while the autonomous course-default model stays deliverable?
budget: Each arm has at most 16 physical classifier fits including refits, 600 s. Run the ordinary planner at its deployed 10-fit default first (or the smaller caller limit); publish its full-data refit before waiting for advice. Both arms then have the same residual budget, runtime method inventory, local alternative and promotion rule for one optional experiment. Four stable independent development scopes, at most one real campus DeepSeek request and RMB 0.12 per paid case, no retries. Stop further paid dispatch on unresolved usage; keep the B outbox for team reconciliation.
treatment: Only the Flash arm asks for an interpretation and one falsifiable diagnosis tied to numbered task/training evidence. Start asynchronously before the first classifier fit. The packet includes redacted instruction excerpts, binding metric/split, fitting-only data summaries, anonymized examples and feasible data checks. Structured declarations take precedence. No task ID, external labels, external features, reference solution or candidate names in this prompt. Raw user comments are not sent. A reply can abstain. Check the diagnosis against measured training evidence and log its status even if refuted or already handled. Store a task-anonymous lesson. Both arms retain the verified ordinary result on rejection/failure. Wait for actionable advice only after that full result exists.
measurement: A proposed hard subset must have at least five examples on each side; look for an error gap of at least 0.05 on out-of-fit core predictions, then consult the available corroborating fold. Select a measured alternative from primary data if it rescues more of those rows. Reuse already measured predictions; screen changed models on two nonoverlapping held sets of training rows with the same incumbent and declared metric. Both deltas must be positive with mean at least 0.003 and a targeted subset must improve on its confirmation as well. Group/time audits inspect actual fold membership; a supported unambiguous instruction can establish an internal constraint before both runs. No model may override a declared metric or split. No new evaluations on course tasks.
panel: s91, UCI Anuran Calls 406, binary membership in the Leptodactylidae family from acoustic features. Exclude genus/species/family as predictors; recording ID represented by an anonymous random code. Up to 1600 unique examples; external fold holds out entire recordings, explicit inner entity protocol. Balanced accuracy.

s92, UCI YouTube Spam Collection 380, binary spam classification from comment content alone. Discard conflicting duplicates, globally deduplicate normalized content. Last video in sorted archive order is the external domain, up to 760 training and 240 external comments. Macro F1.
s93, UCI Semeion Handwritten Digit 178, 16-by-16 images, 10 classes; up to 1200 unique examples, 25 percent stratified external development holdout. Accuracy. Writer identifiers unavailable.

s94, reserved replication in the same unchanged build, UCI Wireless Indoor Localization 422, classify four rooms from seven signal measurements, up to 1200 unique examples, 25 percent stratified external holdout. Macro F1.
freeze: Seeds 261191 to 261194 for sample selection, 261126 for outer splits. Compare the unchanged local core as a free paired reference and verify identical core choices and predictions in both arms. Both final outputs must reload in a separate process. Seal all four pairs and their baseline predictions before opening any outer labels. Report taskwise metric, mean and worst paired delta, changed rows, fit counts, late/invalid calls, protected-delivery and final timing, real tokens and costs. A positive quality signal requires a positive mean, worst loss no more than 0.01 and at least one actually changed evidence-supported experiment. Report engineering success separately. H1/H2, released evaluations and official unseen remain sealed.
